description:
Learn more about Emergent here - https://app.emergent.sh/?via=d61151

In this video, we walk through Clawdbot, an early-stage AI agent that can run through WhatsApp and control parts of your computer. We bring in Sid from 100x Engineers and test real use cases, like ordering groceries, browsing Reddit, and triggering simple workflows through chat commands instead of doing everything manually.   

The main point we make is that agents like this are powerful but extremely literal. They do exactly what you ask, which means clarity and security matter a lot. We explain why running it locally can be risky, why cloud deployment is safer, and how tools like Emergent makes setup easier. We also show how Clawdbot skills work like small reusable programs written in plain English, so you can extend what the agent can do without heavy coding.

The bigger takeaway is that this is a preview of where software is going. AI assistants will not just answer questions, they will browse, click, schedule,
title: Master Clawdbot in 30 Minutes!
